content: Abàlam ŋalàkwikilà
Abun, bi itɛn aben ntɔn nkaa abi Abàlam? Ininà nde kàwɛl unsà imbuur?
Isàkal naa Abàlam bun'twey balàbal u mbwo a isal ande, nde kàlàkal anà ngyal musɛn an'pɛy, wɛɛ kà kusà a Nzam anki.
Apan, Ndaa Aŋàsɔn itɛɛnà aben? Abàlam kàsi làkwikilà amu Nzam, kyakin Nzam kun'twey nde wàbalàbal.
Kyekà, mbuur afàkyer isal mwɛy, làfur làŋàtɔɔl a lää, kà sànaa kab a ngway anki, wɛɛ asànaa nkul.
Isàkal naa mbuur ufàkyer anki isal, wɛɛ nde afàsà làkwikilà akà Mbuur afàtwey baar a man'be balàbal, làkwikilà ande làŋàsà un'tal unsà balàbal.
Kyakin David utɛɛnà nde ntɔn un'sak a mbuur kan'twey Nzam wàbalàbal mukɔɔn alab isal:

content.text: un'sak akà baar bàmadwääl nkul a an'kyän an'be aba, anà bàkyàfwe man'be aba!
Un'sak akà mbuur mpa ufàsyeel Mwol un'tal a man'be ande!

content: Nkye un'sak a kölàköl awà wà ntɔn bàŋàkyɛy mpɛl, lɛɛ wà sye ntɔn baar mpa abàŋàkyɛy? Kyakin, waa bi itɛn naa: làkwikilà a Abàlam bun'syel asànaa balàbal.
La bun'syeel taaŋ nà? Kusà lɛɛ ungö a nkyɛɛy ande? Ŋaa, kà ungö anki, wɛɛ kusà.

Ungö amukun'pà, ba bun'si isii a nkyɛɛy asànaa inyɛm a balàbal kàwɛl nde u mbwo a làkwikilà, utaaŋ kàkäl nde ŋàtun'kyɛy anki. Kyakin awà nde taa a baar banswà mpa abàŋàkyɛy, ntɔn ba sye bàbulà baar a balàbal,
anà taa a bàŋàkyɛy, a baar abà uboo a un'sɛŋ a bàŋàkyɛy mpɛl anki, wɛɛ baar ban'lab sye ntääm a làkwikilà a taaràbi Abàlam, kusà mukun'kyɛy.
Làkwikilà anà ilää a Nzam
Kà ntɔn u mbwo a un'kɔɔn anki, wɛɛ u mbwo a balàbal a làkwikilà naa ilää awal kwal a mɛɛn bàpɛ Abàlam, itàkal itoo ande.
Isàkal naa kwal alà baar bàfàlab un'kɔɔn bàwal la, làkwikilà mfun làfàkal anki, ilää ifàkal anki.
Ntɔn un'kɔɔn afàtwaal nkyɛl. Kyekà, kà ikal ikɔ̈ɔ̈n un'kɔɔn, mbɛɛy a un'kɔɔn sye yatɛy.

Kyakin, ikyee bàfàbulà u mbwo a làkwikilà, ntɔn ya ikäl u mbwo a kab a ngway, ntɔn ilää ikäl ntɔn itoo a Abàlam kyanswà, kà ntɔn baar bàfàlab un'kɔɔn mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye baar bàfàlab làkwikilà a Abàlam, awà taaràbi banswà,

asànaa bàsön ya naa: « Mɛ kabuul taa a in'sɛŋ mbɔɔn. » Nde wà taaràbi kusà a mbuur kàsi nde làkwikilà, Nzam, afàpà akü mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà afàbel indiir mpa byàkäl akà ikikye asànaa bya byàkyàkal.
Ukɔɔn asà an'kyän ande ukwɛl a làkyän lanswà, nde kàsi làkwikilà, waa kàbulà « taar a in'sɛŋ mbɔɔn » asànaa bàtɛn ya a nde naa: « Itoo angye isàkal mbɔɔn. »
Nde kàkäl tsütsü mukɔlà mbul nkam, wɛɛ làkwikilà ande làkäl ka paa, itàkal naa ndür ande yàkäl yàŋàyɔɔn anà un'kyay ande Saal kàkäl ikɔb.
Ukɔɔn asà mpem bwoor akà ilää, nde kàsi ngwal unsà làkwikilà, waa kasi Nzam làkoo.
Ntɔn nde kàkyer ayöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa Nzam usàpà ilää, nde akyer afàkölà kya sye, nde we anà ngwal mukwey kya.
Kyakin bun'twey ba wàbalàbal.
Kyekà, bàsön anki ntɔn nde mpɛl naa: « Nde bun'twey wàbalàbal. »
Wɛɛ ntɔn bi sye, bàsitwey bàbalàbal, bi baar ifàsà làkwikilà amu Nde awà kàwiiy Mwol abi Yɛsu uboo a akü.
Nde bàkyer un'kab ntɔn ibii abi, waa kàwiyà ntɔn mutwey bi bàbalàbal.
